name: keystone-quarry
description: A blocky mining game that teaches kids touch typing.

scripts.build:icon: electron scripts/make-icon.js && iconutil -c icns build/icon.iconset -o build/icon.icns
scripts.pack:mac: npm run build:app && electron-packager . "Keystone Quarry" --platform=darwin --arch=universal --icon=build/icon --app-bundle-id=net.cgallagher.keystonequarry --asar --overwrite --out=dist --ignore="^/(index\.html|README\.md|CHANGELOG\.md|\.gitignore|dist-build\.log|scripts|build|dist)$" && codesign --force --deep --sign - "dist/Keystone Quarry-darwin-universal/Keystone Quarry.app" && hdiutil create -volname "Keystone Quarry" -srcfolder "dist/Keystone Quarry-darwin-universal/Keystone Quarry.app" -ov -format UDZO dist/Keystone-Quarry-mac.dmg
scripts.pack:win: npm run build:app && electron-packager . "Keystone Quarry" --platform=win32 --arch=x64 --icon=build/icon --asar --overwrite --out=dist --ignore="^/(index\.html|README\.md|CHANGELOG\.md|\.gitignore|dist-build\.log|scripts|build|dist)$" && cd dist && rm -f Keystone-Quarry-windows-x64.zip && zip -qry Keystone-Quarry-windows-x64.zip "Keystone Quarry-win32-x64"
scripts.pack: npm run pack:mac && npm run pack:win
